_doc: Set-up / payoff combos. If the target has the set-up status when a matching hit lands, the hit deals x multiplier and (if consume) removes the status. A hit matches if ANY payoff entry matches: one of its elements, its physical damage type (Slash/Pierce/Blunt), its ability type (PHYSICAL/MAGICAL), or its skill name. Basic attacks count too (physical, weapon damage type, no element). Only the best combo applies per hit. Heroes and enemies use the same combos. Code: scripts/resources/Combos.gd.
